style: photorealistic TV commercial, warm evening light, cozy Canadian living room, 35mm film

people.abbu: a friendly Pakistani father in his early 50s with a short neat salt-and-pepper beard, rectangular glasses, wearing a navy blue knit sweater
people.ammi: a Pakistani mother in her mid 40s wearing a maroon shalwar kameez with a cream dupatta over her shoulders
people.bilal: a cheerful Pakistani teenage boy about 16 with short black hair wearing a grey hoodie
people.dadi: a sweet elderly Pakistani grandmother in her 70s with a white dupatta covering her hair and round glasses

scenes.image: medium shot of {abbu} sitting on a beige sofa holding an opened paper bill letter in both hands, staring at it with a shocked face, raised eyebrows
scenes.motion: the man stares at the bill in shock, his eyes widen and he lowers his glasses, slow camera push in
scenes.ur: یہ کیبل کا بل... پھر سے ایک سو بیس ڈالر!

scenes.image: Annoyed Pakistani mother in her mid 40s, maroon shalwar kameez and cream dupatta, standing in a warm living room with hands on her hips, frowning at the camera, medium shot, horizontal frame
scenes.motion: the annoyed mother shakes her head, frowns and waves one hand in frustration while talking
scenes.ur: اور ہمارے ڈرامے پھر بھی نہیں آتے!
scenes.en: And our dramas still don't even come on!

scenes.image: medium shot of {bilal} leaning over the back of the sofa with a big confident smile, holding up a black TV remote control
scenes.motion: the teenage boy grins, lifts a TV remote control into view and gives a thumbs up, camera slowly pushes in
scenes.ur: ابو، کیبل ٹی وی لگا لیں۔ بالکل فری ہے!
scenes.en: Dad, just get Cable TV. It's totally free!

scenes.image: close-up of {abbu} looking surprised and curious, eyebrows raised, a hopeful half smile, sofa and warm lamp behind him
scenes.motion: the man looks up from the paper with raised eyebrows, surprised, then his face breaks into a big hopeful smile

scenes.image: Happy elderly Pakistani grandmother in her 70s with a white dupatta over her hair and round glasses, sitting on a sofa, laughing and clapping with joy while watching TV, colorful TV glow on her face, cozy living room, medium shot, photorealistic
scenes.motion: the grandmother laughs with joy and claps her hands excitedly, then raises both hands in celebration
scenes.ur: واہ! کرکٹ بھی، اور میرا ڈرامہ بھی!
scenes.en: Wow! Cricket, and my drama too!

scenes.image: medium shot of {abbu} laughing happily while tearing a paper bill in half with both hands, the family blurred in the background
scenes.motion: the man bursts out laughing and tears the paper bill in half with both hands, pieces of paper fall, joyful

scenes.image: Over-the-shoulder view from behind a teenage boy with short black hair in a grey hoodie sitting on a sofa, his arm stretched out pointing a black TV remote at a big wall-mounted flat TV showing a colorful grid of TV channels, cozy modern living room, evening, photorealistic
scenes.motion: the boy points the remote at the TV and presses buttons, the TV screen changes channels, camera slowly pushes in

scenes.image: View from behind an elderly grandmother with a white dupatta over her head sitting on a sofa, watching a colorful cricket match on a big flat TV in a cozy warm living room, photorealistic
scenes.motion: the grandmother claps her hands excitedly and raises her arms in joy while the cricket match plays on the TV

end.ur: کیبل ٹی وی، بڑے سمارٹ ٹی وی کے لیے۔ ہر اینڈرائیڈ ٹی وی پر چلے، بالکل فری!
end.en: Cable TV, made for big smart TVs. Works on any Android TV, totally free!
